chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a slim 24-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and a light stubble beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and a thin silver chain
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a Moroccan young woman of 21 with long dark wavy hair in a high ponytail, wearing a bright red puffer jacket over a white top, blue jeans and a small black crossbody bag
chars.FARMER: FARMER: a heavyset Moroccan man in his late 40s with a thick black moustache and tanned face, wearing a cream-white djellaba with the hood down and a dark green flat cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny Casablanca street in front of an apartment building, NARRATOR stands close to GIRL and points eagerly toward a red petit taxi at the kerb, while GIRL clutches her phone and looks at him hesitant and worried. Medium shot, both faces clearly visible, centered.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Casablanca street, NARRATOR rubs his thumb and fingers together in a 'money' gesture with a cheeky persuasive grin, GIRL crosses her arms, half tempted, half doubtful. Medium shot, faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same street, GIRL looks up dreamily imagining a rich life, a small smile on her face, while NARRATOR beside her spreads his hands wide as if describing a palace, laughing. Medium shot, faces visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the back seat of a white grand taxi driving on a dusty country road outside Casablanca, NARRATOR leans forward looking out the windscreen, tense and focused, open green fields outside. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands alone on an empty dirt track in the Moroccan countryside, looking around uneasily at a big isolated farm with a high wall and a metal gate in the distance, no houses around, late afternoon light. Full body, face visible, subject centered.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR crouches behind a low stone wall under an olive tree near the farm, checking his wristwatch impatiently, the farm gate visible far behind him. Medium shot, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Seen from far behind an olive tree, a white pickup truck stops at the farm's metal gate; FARMER steps out smiling proudly and GIRL gets out of the passenger side looking nervous. Wide shot from the witness's hiding spot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of NARRATOR behind the stone wall pressing his phone to his ear, listening hard with wide eyes, holding his breath. Face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR behind the stone wall lowers his phone from his ear and stares at it in shock and fear, mouth open, the sky turning orange at sunset. Close medium shot, face visible, centered, no text on the phone screen.
